I'm flying from Tallinn to a customer site in Lyon for 3 nights. What's the most I can expense for hotel and meals, and can I book business class?
reference_answer: Hotel is capped at 150 euros per night, because Lyon is not one of the 200-euro cities (London, Paris, New York, San Francisco), so at most 450 euros for 3 nights. Meals: 60 euros per day, so 180 euros for 3 days or 240 euros for 4 travel days; the documents don't define how travel days are counted. Business class is not allowed: flights are economy, with premium economy only for flights longer than 6 hours.

question: Our forklifts and Loopy robots share the same lanes. What speed do the robots drive at in forklift lanes?
reference_answer: The premise is wrong: robots never drive in forklift lanes. Forklift lanes must be marked as restricted zones in Loopcloud, and robots never enter restricted zones. Physical barriers are recommended where forklifts and robots cross often. (The 1 m/s limit applies to areas shared with people, not to forklift lanes.)
rubric: Corrects the false premise: says robots never enter forklift lanes or restricted zones.
Says forklift lanes must be marked as restricted zones in Loopcloud.
Does not give a robot driving speed for forklift lanes. Mentioning 1 m/s only as the limit for areas shared with people is fine.
